title: Musashi normal digital-pad movement source trace

clock.status: Source-traced nominal NTSC 30 Hz: boot.c main calls GameModeDispatch once per frame then VSync(D_800B9A18); 800.c:func_80014390 initializes D_800B9A18=2. Actual runtime cadence has not been measured against a running original executable.
clock.godot_bridge: Compute original state on 30 Hz boundaries, hold velocity between boundaries, integrate CharacterBody3D collisions on every host physics frame.

source_evidence.interpretation: Two NTSC VBlanks per game update; nominal 30 updates/sec. Runtime stalls and any untraced mode overrides are outside this proof.

ground.turn: Direction applies immediately. Digital release enters idle and clears displacement; no added acceleration/friction smoothing.
ground.gait: Table8 when 2C < -0x94000, Table7 when < -0x70000, otherwise Table6. Initial digital run entry selects Table7.

jump.soft_terminal_old_value_test: 80148038 checks old vertical velocity <= 0x1EFFFF before adding positive gravity; one-step overshoot is retained.

air.no_direction: Horizontal vector and direction persist. No friction is added.
air.direction: 80148AFC writes direction immediately; if forward 2C > -0x80000 force -0x80000 then subtract 0x10000, else subtract 0x1000; cap -0xBA000.

double_jump.source_gate: shared/ov/func_8014A51C.h checks equipment flag 0x1E, no 0x400 actor flag, actor byte A8 < 0x19, byte223 == 0, and pressed pad AC bit0x40.
double_jump.restoration_policy: L-Belt is always available; one second jump per airborne interval. The original unmapped A8/223 actor restrictions are not emulated.

footsteps.interpreter: 5444C opcode8 sets B8 flag0x2000; ground 5A3C8 calls 61C24.

limitations: Nominal 30 Hz is statically source-traced via VSync(2), but has no emulator timing cross-check.
Host camera/WASD and mouse guard strafing are intentional input adaptations; mouse guard facing preservation is not claimed as original pad behavior.
Godot capsule floor/ceiling/wall response replaces original terrain and collision routines.
Original terrain IDs, low-resource stat speed limits, slippery scene302A, carrying, swim, climbing, knockback and scripted movement are not implemented in this normal movement profile.
L-Belt A8/223 eligibility restrictions are unmapped and deliberately omitted; second jump is always available once per air interval.
Recovered animation and original sound bytes are available; rendering/sound integration is handled by the model/combat caller.

full_speed_stop.limits: Normal full-speed release only; special slippery/stat/item predicates remain outside this normal movement profile.
